progress.summary: The stacked exemplar now uses two zero-dead-zone 28vh transition packets. Each read-only rail and its short caption share one deterministic scroll projection; an equal-and-opposite paint transform simulates a lock while native document flow and the retained graph clock continue unchanged. Rail fill reports linear corridor travel, graph motion preserves authored sub-beats, direct links seek without replay, reverse is exact, and reduced-motion/phone readers retain ordinary flow. Mandatory human review remains before startup-attribution or promotion.
